name: fxr_forest_ambush_alone
doc: Stands in for saves/forest_re/batalha_nao_comeca.raw.wram (the owner's capture of the Beetles and Avian Chaos ambush in Guardia Forest with Crono alone, storyline 03): from the forest's south entry (fxr_forest_alone) Crono walks a BFS route over the cartridge's own planes (tools/playthrough.py route_walk) to tile (21,22), steps right, up two rows and left into obj24, the ambush's touch trigger (op B2): he stops at (15B0,147F) and control drops (f61 of the approach); cut 18 frames later, the enemies walking in, the battle not yet staged ($0117 = 00).
